decision: Keep KDE system keyboard mapping during explicit Lay IME enable and select the existing IBus profile matching the current named KDE layout. No KDE group setter or additional runtime owner.
reason: Measured IBus profile activation replaces the KDE dual map by default; preserving it does not itself align the current group and profile. Private fixture setup must not masquerade as shipped startup behavior.
verification: Real shell isolation tests, current-name readback before/after ordinary IBus activation, GNOME and daemon-only control preservation. Include these startup regressions in changed and full source gates; no checks are removed or relaxed. A bounded list/index/list read retries only changing or out-of-range snapshots during device startup; malformed and unsupported snapshots still refuse before mutation. Native RFB client checks remain separate.
not_tested: Other KDE/IBus versions and Wayland remote-input capability are not established by startup source tests.
